name: Band External Rotation
steps: Stand sideways to an elbow-height resistance band anchor and hold the band in your outside hand.
Tuck your working elbow snugly against your ribs bent at 90 degrees with your forearm across your stomach.
Rotate your forearm smoothly outward away from your torso while keeping your elbow pinned to your side.
Guide your hand slowly back across your front, then turn around and switch arms after finishing one side.
tips: Keep your wrist straight in line with your forearm throughout the rotation.
Tuck a folded towel between your elbow and ribs if your elbow tends to drift outward.
